name: Airi
source:
An AI existing within Iru-O created by Kimijima, with another personality (Geji-nee) that is used by him to collect information. [spoiler]She subconciously spies on Kaito for Kimijima. When the Iru-O servers are rebooted on Christmas Airi's personality is erased and Geji-nee returns to Kimijima's side.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://myanimelist.net/character/60161/Airi_Yukifune]MyAnimeList[/url]]
